notes.title: Crime Passional - 1.2.0 Minor Update
notes.content:
-Game optimization was improved
-Minor bugs were fixed
-Game brightness was fixed
-All the game options now properly save
-Fixed a bug that caused some achievements to be unlocked in the game but not in Steam (If this happen to you, just restart the game once and all the missing achievements in Steam will be unlocked)
-Native support for Linux was added

Sorry for not updating this game in a long time. If you face or found some bug or problem, write to me in https://discord.gg/AygFDaujxC
